data.title: Child supplement application rejected
data.summary: The Familienkasse Muster-Mitte rejected your application of 6 October 2025 for child supplement (Kinderzuschlag) for October 2025 to March 2026. Your household income is above the maximum income limit.
data.explanation: The family benefits office (Familienkasse) has refused your child supplement application because your household's income is above the legal upper limit. The calculation is in an attachment that is not part of this text. If you disagree, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing, electronically or in person at the office. The app shows the deadline for this. If you do nothing, the decision becomes final. Consider getting advice, for example from a social counselling service, if you want to challenge the calculation.
